fields.uuid: Stable local draft and eventual native receipt UUID; never reuse after discard.
fields.shop_id: Only the active shop on this device may open or change the draft.
fields.revision: Optimistic local revision prevents stale editors overwriting or posting a newer draft.
fields.status: editing/posted; posted marker commits with stock and prevents duplicate confirmation.
fields.payload: Device-local header, product snapshots, target UUIDs and import rows. Never row-sync; full SQLite backup only.
fields.updated_at: Device-local save time, independent of effective purchase date.

fields.uuid: Stable document identity; preserve across retries and restore.
fields.shop_id: Scope to the active authenticated shop.
fields.payload: Whole immutable header and line snapshots via purchase-receipts/native and purchase-receipts/changes; never post stock on import.
fields.origin: Preserve web/android origin from the document.
fields.sync_state: Device runtime: pending/error/synced/local; downloaded documents start synced.
fields.last_error: Device runtime: retain actionable rejection; never upload.
fields.created_at: Document audit time; original phone time remains device_created_at in payload after acknowledgement.
fields.purchase_date: Preserve the effective receipt date independently of sync order.
fields.deleted_at: Reserved local tombstone; posted corrections require a future audited API.
